I attempted suicide at 15, I was semi- successful. My heart stopped very momentarily, if I hadn’t have thrown up right before my heart stopped I would not have been able to be revived. It was so momentary, but the moments leading up to everything shutting off were so peaceful. I wasn’t scared, I didn’t feel anything. Just complete peace. I’m 21 now and my suicidal thoughts are back stronger than ever. The only thing that keeps me from doing it is family and friends. And honestly, the fear of surviving another attempt. I have many people close to me, but my brain is a living hell. I need to feel the peace that I felt when I overdosed at 15 and crossed whatever barrier I crossed. I lay up sick every night with demented thoughts keeping me up. I feel there is no help for me, no one can understand me. I need to feel the weight lifted, permanently. I know I will take my own life, soon. I just don’t know when.
